summary: First public-install Codex sample stopped during narration preparation, before any creative task or ExecutionAttempt. The generic Edge TTS boundary error is confirmed; its underlying cause is not recoverable from saved evidence. Stop behavior was correct. Retain this as a failed public black-box sample.

run.hostExitMeaning: The Agent finished reporting; this is not production or delivery success.

originalError.message: Edge TTS request failed for chunk choose-step-2.

failure.explanation: Adapter catch covers ttsPromise rejection, readFile failure and empty audio; it discards the original error/cause and deletes the temporary directory. No lower-level provider error was found in saved transcript/stdout or stopped-Workspace logs. Elapsed time is not proof of timeout.

promiseReview.confirmed: ttsPromise resolves in the audio write stream finish callback after turn.end. The adapter awaits it before readFile. No statically demonstrated read-before-write-finish misuse was found.
promiseReview.limits: This rules out that narrow adapter race, not all provider/library/host defects. No live TTS call or network reproduction was performed.

processAssessment.ownership: Root created authoring input and used public CLI. The only child copied the exact temporary capability challenge, which Root verified and removed. No creative task ownership or commit existed to cross.

minorIssues.description: After reading the long-wait rule, Root requested a 1-second process wait (actual host minimum was about 5 seconds), then a 1-second outer-cell renewal and a 10-second renewal. It subsequently/otherwise used the original process correctly. These short waits were unnecessary renewals, not failed calls or the cause of failure.

minorIssues.description: The final accurately said no video/covers were produced, but presupposed a service fault. Evidence proves a narration boundary failure only; adapter catch also covers file I/O/empty output. Underlying cause must remain unknown.

stoppedWorkspace.attemptDirectoryCaveat: Contains .gitkeep plus one .processes diagnostic record; this is not an ExecutionAttempt. Recorded processes were absent at read-only ps inspection.
